headline_seed: Trump’s approval plunges into the 20s, and Republicans give up - The Hill
draft_text:
Trump's approval sits at 35% (Economist/YouGov) — a near-record low. CNN puts it at roughly one-third, with only 13% strongly approving. USA Today and CNN both peg Democratic generic-ballot leads at 8 to 14 points heading into November 2026.

And that's the mews.
